declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. 2 of the 23 pending cases qualify: one (Cr No.209/2015, 1 Town PS Anantapur; CC No.71/2018) includes IPC 307 (attempt to murder) and 364 (kidnapping/abduction to murder); another (Cr No.324/2021, Kuppam PS Chittoor) is charged under Section 3 of the Prevention of Damage to Public Property Act, which carries a maximum of 5 years. The other 21 pending cases involve only public-order/disobedience sections (IPC 34/120B/143/147/149/151(CrPC)/153A/188/228A/295A/341/353/448/505/509 and similar) that individually top out under 5 years. Separately, 2 convictions (both IPC 188, fines of Rs 100 each, 2016) are not serious.
